meta.title: Paper Reader
meta.description: Paper library with section outline, KaTeX math rendering, bilingual translation, ask-the-agent about a selection, per-paper `<paper>.notes.md` notes, and a `paper` tool for the model.

library.title: Library
library.emptyHint: Use the ＋ button to add a paper directory, or put papers in one of these.

roots.title: Paper directories
roots.hint: The library scans these directories for .tex / .pdf files. Changes are saved immediately; no config file editing needed.
roots.emptyPath: Enter or pick a directory first
roots.pickUnavailable: No directory picker available; paste the path instead

reader.placeholder: Pick a paper on the left
reader.truncated: Content truncated; use the paper tool to read full sections.
reader.pdfNoText: This PDF has no extractable text layer (scan). Read the pages in the right preview, or use a text-based copy.
reader.pdfNoTool: No pdftotext available on the host, so PDF text cannot be extracted. Read it in the right preview.
reader.previewUnavailable: The right preview service is unavailable on this host
reader.askUnavailable: No conversation session available; open or create one first
reader.pdfPageModeHint: Render the original pages with pdf.js for comfortable reading
reader.pdfTextModeHint: Switch back to the searchable, copyable text view
reader.pdfFailedHint: If you see a 404 or module load error, restart DeepSeek Harness so the new host routes take effect; you can also open the original file with ↗ in the header.
reader.pdfHint: Select text to explain or quote it
reader.pdfNoBrowser: PDF rendering is unavailable in this environment (browser Canvas and Worker required).

ask.explain: Explain this passage: what it says, what each symbol means, in plain language.
ask.critique: Challenge this passage: is the argument valid? Any hidden assumptions, gaps, or counterexamples? Point at the exact sentence.
ask.review: Read this passage as a reviewer: could it be a rejection reason? Give concrete, prioritized fixes.

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: No notes yet. Select text and press Quote, or let the model write them with the paper tool.
